modules.module_title: Handle tools and instruments used at the surveying site as per the instructions.

pcs.pc_description: identify different type of chains, measuring tapes, offsets, levelling equipment, measuring instruments, and other tools/instruments(levelling staff, arrows, pegs) used in surveying work
handle chains/ tapes with precision while taking measurements
handle different types of offsets and use them according to the directions given by surveyor
handle levelling equipment such as dumpy level auto level tilting level etc during surveying work
handle different types of angle measuring instruments like tachometer, theodolite etc
handle other tools used in surveying like levelling staff, arrows, pegs etc. to assist the surveyor
handle other miscellaneous instruments used in various surveys like GPS, photogrammetry, different types of transits etc. under the supervision of surveyor

modules.module_title: Store tools and instruments used in surveying work as per standard procedure.

pcs.pc_description: store and stack the surveying tools and instruments at designated location/ warehouse, as per standard practices/ manufacturer's guidelines
stack and store different surveying materials such as lime, strings, hurdles, paints etc. according to standard practices or instructions

modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory works related to linear and angular measurement

pcs.pc_description: collect the required number of tools and instruments as per the instructions of the surveyor
lift and shift materials surveying tools and equipment to the instructed location following the ergonomic principles
place the tripod appropriately at the station mark and attach the instrument/equipment to it as per the
report to seniors in case of any ambiguity or deviations

modules.module_title: Assist in linear measurements of distances and lengths

pcs.pc_description: unfold the chain or tape as per standard practices
fix the ranging rod at the indicated point to mark the starting point as per instructions
start the measurements from the exact point as per instructions
interpret the hand signals shown by surveyor for ranging correctly and follow them
fix arrows at every chain length under the guidance of surveyor

modules.module_title: Assist in angular measurement and leveling

pcs.pc_description: place the instruments equipment used for angular measurement leveling appropriately at the location/ point instructed by the surveyor
select the staff based on the type of instrument being used
locate and confirm the staff point as instructed by the surveyor
place the staff perpendicular to the surface of base with precision while the readings of angular / level measurement are being noted down by surveyor

modules.module_title: Assist in setting out as per the layout/work plan

pcs.pc_description: mark the points using suitable means during layout setting work as instructed by surveyor
install hurdles/profiles at marked locations maintaining their tops at approximately same level
install nails on the top of the fixed hurdles profiles as per instructions given by surveyor
mark symbols such as grid numbers using appropriate colored paints to denote the identification of point
connect line thread strings to respective nails on profile for marking appropriate layout
mark layouts for excavations other civil work using lime as per the layout plan the set up of the thread string and instruction given by the surveyor
collect and count all tools and instruments after completion of survey
shift the tools back to the store and stack the same as per standard practice

modules.module_title: Follow safety norms as defined by the organization

pcs.pc_description: identify and report any hazards, risks or breaches in site safety to the appropriate authority
follow emergency and evacuation procedures in case of accidents, fires, natural calamities
follow recommended safe practices in handling construction materials, including chemical and hazardous material whenever applicable
follow all the protocols and safety techniques conveyed during safety awareness programs like Tool Box Talks, safety demonstrations and mock drills conducted at the site

identify near miss, unsafe condition and unsafe act

use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) as per work requirements for : Head Protection, Ear protection, Fall Protection ,Foot Protection, Face and Eye Protection, Hand and Body Protection , and Respiratory Protection (if required)

follow safe disposal of waste, harmful and hazardous materials as per EHS guidelines

apply ergonomic principles wherever required

clean and disinfect all materials, tools and supplies before and after use
